proposal.summary: Improper privilege management in PhoneStatusBarPolicy in System UI prior to SMR Mar-2023 Release 1 allows an attacker to turn off Do not disturb via an unprotected intent.
proposal.affected_product: System UI prior to SMR Mar-2023 Release 1

AV.quote: allows attacker to turn off Do not disturb via unprotected intent.

PR.quote: allows attacker to turn off Do not disturb via unprotected intent.

C.quote: allows attacker to turn off Do not disturb via unprotected intent.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the unprotected intent in PhoneStatusBarPolicy; identify intent receiver and add appropriate permission checks or make the intent protected; backport fix to releases prior to SMR Mar-2023 Release 1.

evidence_quotes.quote: Improper privilege management vulnerability in PhoneStatusBarPolicy in System UI prior to SMR Mar-2023 Release 1 allows attacker to turn off Do not disturb via unprotected intent.
